basic_details.job_title: Kalaburagi District Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Principal District and Sessions Judge's Court, Kalaburagi (Kalaburagi District Court), Karnataka, has invited applications for 5 posts of Stenographer Grade-3 under Advt No. ಜಿನ್ಯಾ ಕ/ಆಡಳಿತ/18/2026. The online application is open from 16 November 2026 to 15 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online through net banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI via the link on the court website; challan, DD, postal order and money order not accepted. Last date to pay the fee: 17 December 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Minimum 18 years; maximum not more than 35+5 years (General), 38+5 years (Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B), 40+5 years (SC / ST / Category-1) (as on the last date for submission of application)

qualification.education_qualification: Second PUC pass or Diploma in Commercial Practice (KBTE) or equivalent, plus Senior Grade Kannada and English shorthand and typewriting, or a Commercial/Secretarial Practice diploma with these subjects as printed
qualification.details: Qualification: Passed second year Pre-University course examination conducted by the Department of Pre-University Education as on the last date for applications, or Diploma in Commercial Practice conducted by the Karnataka Board of Technical Examinations, or equivalent qualification; Passed Senior Grade Kannada and English shorthand and Senior Grade Kannada and English typewriting examinations conducted by the Department of Public Instruction, Government of Karnataka; OR passed Diploma in Commercial Practice (KBTE) with Kannada and English shorthand and typewriting as optional subjects; OR; Passed Diploma in Commercial Practice / Secretarial Practice with shorthand and typewriting in either Kannada or English, and passed the remaining Kannada / English shorthand and typewriting examination in Senior Grade conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board Age limit: Minimum 18 years; maximum not more than 35+5 years (General), 38+5 years (Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B), 40+5 years (SC / ST / Category-1) (as on the last date for submission of application) Age relaxation: Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B Maximum 38+5 years, SC / ST / Category-1 Maximum 40+5 years, One-time relaxation 5 years for all categories as per GO No. CASUE 262 SENENI 2025 dated 29.01.2026 (included in the +5), Karnataka Govt / local authority / state corporation employees Years of service or 10 years, whichever is less, Ex-servicemen Years of service in armed forces plus 3 years, Persons with disabilities, widows, bonded labourers 10 years, Census organisation (Govt of India) in Karnataka Years of service or 5 years, whichever is less, NCC full-time instructors (released) Years served, Village group trainers (state rural employment scheme) Years served | Other conditions: | In-service candidates must hold a No Objection Certificate from the authority concerned Mobile number is mandatory in the online application

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay scale Rs. 44425-83700 and other allowances

how_to_apply: Apply online only through the link on https://kalaburagi.dcourts.gov.in/Judges/online-recruitment/ between 16.11.2026 and 15.12.2026 (11.59 PM).
Enter a mobile number (mandatory) and email ID if available.
Upload a recent colour photograph (5 cm x 3.6 cm, 50 KB) and signature in black ballpoint pen on white paper.
Fill all details and pay the fee online by 17.12.2026.
Download the application and keep it and the SBI E-pay receipt until the recruitment is over.
important_instructions: Fee once paid will not be refunded Candidates must download the interview eligibility list from the court website and produce it at the interview SSLC / II PUC grades or CGPA must be converted to marks and entered No correspondence with the office will be entertained Enquiries: 08472 221856 (10.00 AM to 6.00 PM)

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Passed second year Pre-University course examination conducted by the Department of Pre-University Education as on the last date for applications, or Diploma in Commercial Practice conducted by the Karnataka Board of Technical Examinations, or equivalent qualification; Passed Senior Grade Kannada and English shorthand and Senior Grade Kannada and English typewriting examinations conducted by the Department of Public Instruction, Government of Karnataka; OR passed Diploma in Commercial Practice (KBTE) with Kannada and English shorthand and typewriting as optional subjects; OR; Passed Diploma in Commercial Practice / Secretarial Practice with shorthand and typewriting in either Kannada or English, and passed the remaining Kannada / English shorthand and typewriting examination in Senior Grade conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board Age limit: Minimum 18 years; maximum not more than 35+5 years (General), 38+5 years (Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B), 40+5 years (SC / ST / Category-1) (as on the last date for submission of application) Age relaxation: Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B Maximum 38+5 years, SC / ST / Category-1 Maximum 40+5 years, One-time relaxation 5 years for all categories as per GO No. CASUE 262 SENENI 2025 dated 29.01.2026 (included in the +5), Karnataka Govt / local authority / state corporation employees Years of service or 10 years, whichever is less, Ex-servicemen Years of service in armed forces plus 3 years, Persons with disabilities, widows, bonded labourers 10 years, Census organisation (Govt of India) in Karnataka Years of service or 5 years, whichever is less, NCC full-time instructors (released) Years served, Village group trainers (state rural employment scheme) Years served Other conditions: In-service candidates must hold a No Objection Certificate from the authority concerned Mobile number is mandatory in the online application

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Kalaburagi District Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Certificates obtained after the last date (except Kannada medium study certificate) will not be considered Applications without fee will be rejected

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Probation of 2 years under the Karnataka Civil Services (Probation) Rules, 1977 Must pass prescribed departmental examinations and Kannada language examination during probation Must pass computer literacy test with 50% marks before probation ends

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online through net banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI via the link on the court website; challan, DD, postal order and money order not accepted. Last date to pay the fee: 17 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will Kalaburagi District Court Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Skill test: dictation in Kannada and English at 120 words per minute for 5 minutes, transcription on computer in 45 minutes Interview (10 marks) Dictation in Kannada and English at 120 words per minute for 5 minutes Transcription on computer within 45 minutes Skill test: maximum 100 marks each in Kannada and English Interview carries 10 marks List of candidates eligible for interview will be published on the court website

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: SBI e-pay receipt of fee paid SSLC marks card / transfer certificate / cumulative record for date of birth Caste / category certificate in prescribed form (if claimed) Rural reservation certificate in Form-1 and Form-2 (if claimed) Kalyana-Karnataka (371-J) local candidate eligibility certificate (if applying under it) Two conduct certificates from respectable persons and school conduct certificate; NOC for in-service candidates

Enter a mobile number (mandatory) and email ID if available. Upload a recent colour photograph (5 cm x 3.6 cm, 50 KB) and signature in black ballpoint pen on white paper. Fill all details and pay the fee online by 17.12.2026. Download the application and keep it and the SBI E-pay receipt until the recruitment is over.
